concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-in-person-payments-donations-in-person]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms terminal/standalone Giving guide for a separate donation after an eligible sale, campaign and software prerequisites, two-step receipt lookup and merchant `DONATION` webhook outcome.
warnings: This Platforms guide does not establish a successful donation or nonprofit bank receipt; keep its in-person route separate from online Giving.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-in-person-payments-donations-in-person]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms in-person Giving implementation guide for user account-holder campaigns, distinct sale/donation transactions, terminal receipt lookup and donation-outcome webhook.
warnings: No split instruction is allowed on the donation transaction; original-sale splits do not identify nonprofit funds receipt.
